Manorbier range firing/flying notice

Dates and times of planned live firing for Manorbier firing range.

From:
Ministry of Defence and Defence Infrastructure Organisation
Published:
2 June 2011
Last updated:
28 August 2026 — See all updates

Documents

Air Defence Range Manorbier September 2026

HTML

Air Defence Range Manorbier byelaws

PDF, 197 KB, 7 pages

Air Defence Range Manorbier August 2026

HTML

Details

Do not enter the danger area when the range is in use, this is a danger to life. Learn more about accessing MOD training areas safely.

Timings are liable to change at short notice.
